visualCharacteristics.notes: Thin-rule accordion with bold titles and +/- icons; open panels lay out label/value specification groups in a responsive grid.

contentPattern.structure: per panel: title | spec groups, each a label (heading h3-h6 or wholly bold paragraph) followed by value paragraphs/lists; wholly italic paragraphs are sub-labels

suitableFor: label/value technical data grouped into panels
notSuitableFor: FAQ-style question/answer accordions with long prose (use accordion)
